subject: PO authorization headers, month-end sweep, and tiered discount alignment
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aria Soto <aria.soto@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: PO header requirements + monthly sweep questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things before we convert the POC LOE to an initial 12-month commitment. Main asks:

- PO header: they require a formal "Purchase Order" header with our legal name and Redwood's vendor ID in the top-right (their template attached). Will you be able to accept their template as-is or do we need a vendor-side override?
- Invoice cadence: Greenleaf runs a month-end sweep (invoices dated on the last business day, payments processed in the first week of the following month). Can we align invoicing to that cadence, and is there any minimum invoice amount we should be aware of?
- Net terms: their treasury team typically requests Net 60 for enterprise pilots. Is a Net 60 approval possible or do we need to route through finance for exceptions?

I've attached the Greenleaf PO template for reference. CC'ing Aria from procurement who will shepherd the PO.

Best,
Tom

Attachment: Greenleaf_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf, 92KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Aria Soto <aria.soto@greenleafhealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: PO header requirements + monthly sweep questions

Hi Tom / Aria —

Thanks for the template, looks straightforward. Quick answers up front:

- PO header: We can accept a PO with a custom header, but accounting needs the following fields present in the header area to auto-ingest: Vendor Name ("Redwood Inference, Inc."), Redwood Vendor ID #RID-4127, Billing Address, and a PO number. If Greenleaf can map those fields into the template, we should be OK.
- Invoice cadence: We can issue invoices dated on the last business day to match your sweep. Finance prefers invoices consolidated monthly; we can aggregate multiple SKUs into a single month-end invoice to keep AP work minimal. There is no hard minimum invoice amount, but smaller invoices under $200 can trigger manual handling on our side.
- Net terms: Net 60 is outside our default Net 30 for pilots. I'll loop in Vivek (commercial) and Ben (finance) to validate approvals and any pricing/noise tradeoffs for extended terms.

Two asks from our side: 1) can you confirm the exact PO header fields Greenleaf will populate, and 2) if Net 60 is required, would Greenleaf be open to a small discount adjustment or pre-commitment milestone to offset cashflow (this is common for Net>30 requests).

I'll wait for Vivek/Ben to add details on the pricing/terms side.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: PO header requirements + monthly sweep questions

Marissa / Ben — quick internal notes on the Greenleaf asks.

On Thu, Nov 25, 2026 at 5:08 PM, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - Net terms: Net 60 is outside our default Net 30 for pilots.

Ben: any chance we can approve Net 60 for a $120k ARR ARR-runner pilot if they commit to a 12-month minimum? A few points to consider:
- We can propose a 1.5% fee to extend to Net 60 (finance common approach), OR
- Offer a small 3% volume discount applied to the first invoice month if they sign a 12-month commitment (no retroactive credits).

If finance won't accept either, AVPs prefer routing to Sales Ops for a special exception with CFO sign-off; that will add ~5 business days. We're trying to avoid delaying onboarding.

Also, for the PO header auto-ingest: Ben, can you confirm the vendor ID and whether we can accept the PO without an e-invoice portal mapping? We should be able to auto-ingest PDFs that include the vendor ID and PO number in the top-right.

Vivek
Head of Sales, Enterprise

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO header requirements + monthly sweep questions

Vivek / Marissa —

We can support Net 60 for this account with the following guardrails:

1) Finance-approved extended term process: add a one-time financing fee of 1.75% on invoices covered by the extended terms (applied to the first month invoice). This is consistent with our enterprise pilot playbook.
2) Require a signed 12-month commitment (SOW or MSA addendum) stating minimum spend thresholds; if they terminate early we reserve the right to reconcile to list pricing.
3) For invoicing: we can accept Greenleaf's PDF PO template as long as the header includes Vendor Name (Redwood Inference, Inc.), Vendor ID RID-4127, PO number, and Billing Address. Our AP team will auto-ingest PDFs that clearly show those fields.

On discounts: we prefer the milestone-based 3% waiver approach (apply a one-time 3% credit in month one) instead of lowering base price. It's simpler to reconcile and avoids long-term margin erosion.

If Tom/Aria accept the fee + 12-month commitment + one-time 3% onboarding credit, finance will sign off and we can proceed with Net 60 and month-end consolidated invoices.

Ben
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Aria Soto <aria.soto@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: PO header requirements + monthly sweep questions

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement confirms Greenleaf can populate the header fields you listed and will include Redwood Vendor ID RID-4127 in the top-right. We accept the one-time 1.75% financing fee to enable Net 60 and will sign a 12-month SOW (we'll share a countersigned SOW draft by tomorrow).

We also prefer the one-time 3% onboarding credit applied to the first consolidated invoice rather than a permanent price change.

Next steps:
- I will upload the signed PO (using our template) to the shared drive once legal finishes stamping the SOW.
- Tom will send the PO number and the expected first invoice date (month-end 2026-11-30) in the next email.

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to get started.

Best,
Aria
Senior Procurement Manager, Greenleaf Health
